rationale: New files in the exported render directory: the typed GPU pass API (gpu_pass, gpu_capabilities, wgsl_diagnostics), its Dawn implementation, the WGSL compile helper shared with the build-time validator, and the padded-row readback helper Renderer3D now uses. They depend only on Pulp's render, canvas, runtime and platform layers and Dawn's public WebGPU API, with nothing Pulp-only, so the next re-export carries them and Vellum gets the same typed pass API on its device.
